segment_captions.caption: A person sits on a stool in front of a shop window filled with colorful posters and signs. The text 'REMARKABLE LIVING DESTINATIONS' appears on the screen.
A serene landscape featuring lush greenery, rice paddies, and traditional structures amidst palm trees under a cloudy sky.

A lush, green valley with rice paddies and palm trees. The camera pans slowly across the landscape, revealing more of the dense vegetation and the tranquil water bodies. The sky is overcast, adding a serene atmosphere to the scene.
The camera pans across a lush, green valley surrounded by dense palm trees and other vegetation, showcasing the natural beauty of Sidemen.
The camera pans from a lush tropical forest to a waterfall cascading over rocks surrounded by greenery.
A waterfall cascades over rocks amidst lush greenery, followed by a view of a tree trunk with hanging leaves against a clear sky.

A person wearing a blue helmet and yellow clothing walks through a lush, green field with rows of crops. The text overlay reads, 'the rivers, the mountains, the hills' and 'It is just a very organic, natural way of Bali at its best.'

A person wearing a blue helmet and yellow outfit walks through a lush green field. The scene transitions to a wide shot of terraced rice paddies surrounded by palm trees, indicating a rural landscape.

A serene view of rice terraces surrounded by lush greenery and palm trees. The camera pans slowly across the landscape, highlighting the tranquil beauty of the area. Text appears on screen: 'BALI'S HIDDEN GEM'.
A serene view of Sidemen Valley, East Bali, with misty fields and a prominent mountain in the background. The text 'SIDEMEN VALLEY, EAST BALI' appears on screen.

A scenic view of Sidemen Valley, East Bali, with lush green terraced fields and a misty mountain in the background. The camera pans slowly across the landscape, revealing more of the valley's natural beauty and the surrounding forested hills.

A scenic view of Sidemen Valley with lush green terraced fields and dense forested hills in the background. The camera pans slightly to reveal a road lined with palm trees and utility poles, with a car parked on the side. Text overlay indicates the distance from Bali Airport.
A tranquil waterfall cascades down a rocky cliff, surrounded by lush greenery. The scene is serene, with no visible human interaction or movement.
A woman stands overlooking lush green rice terraces and waterfalls, with Mount Agung in the background.
A woman stands overlooking lush green rice terraces and waterfalls, with Mount Agung in the distance. The scene captures the serene beauty of the landscape.
Tracey Rackliff, owner of Samanvaya Resort, speaks about Mount Agung, the most famous and biggest mountain in Bali.
The camera pans up to show a scenic view of a mountain surrounded by lush greenery and palm trees under a partly cloudy sky.
The camera pans along a scenic road flanked by lush greenery and palm trees, leading towards a mountainous backdrop under a partly cloudy sky.

Aerial view of lush rice terraces surrounded by dense greenery and mountains. The camera pans slowly across the landscape, highlighting the intricate patterns of the terraces and the vibrant greenery below.
Aerial view of rice terraces and palm trees, transitioning to a closer shot of a house with a tiled roof surrounded by lush greenery and mountains in the background.

The camera pans across a lush landscape featuring tall palm trees and a traditional house with a tiled roof. The scene transitions to show more of the surrounding greenery and distant hills under a partly cloudy sky.

A woman in a yellow top and patterned skirt walks up stone steps towards a temple structure adorned with intricate carvings. The surrounding lush greenery and distant hills are visible under a cloudy sky.
A woman in a yellow top and patterned skirt walks up stone steps towards a temple, surrounded by lush greenery and palm trees under a cloudy sky.

A man climbs a palm tree, reaching up to gather coconuts. He holds a large bundle of coconuts in his arms, carefully maneuvering through the branches. The scene is set against a backdrop of lush greenery and a clear sky.

C climbs down from a palm tree, holding a bundle of leaves. The scene transitions to a wide shot of Sidemen village, showcasing traditional houses and lush greenery. Text overlay explains Sidemen's transition from farming to a cultural tourist destination.

A lush tropical landscape with vibrant flowers and greenery surrounding traditional thatched-roof houses. The text overlay reads: 'Originally a farming region, Sidemen is transitioning into a cultural tourist destination.'

A scenic view of Sidemen Valley, showcasing lush greenery and traditional houses nestled among rice terraces. The text overlay explains that Sidemen was originally a farming region transitioning into a cultural tourist destination.

The camera pans across the Sidemen Valley, revealing a lush landscape with scattered houses and rice terraces. Smoke rises from a distant area, indicating some activity or fire. The valley is surrounded by dense greenery and hills, showcasing its natural beauty and rural setting.

A close-up of an intricately carved stone sculpture featuring a fierce dragon-like figure with sharp teeth and detailed scales. The camera remains stationary, focusing on the texture and craftsmanship of the sculpture.
The camera pans from a close-up of a intricately carved stone dragon statue to reveal a temple structure in the background, emphasizing its cultural significance.
The camera pans from a large temple gate to reveal smaller temples surrounded by lush greenery.
C walks towards a temple, holding a bouquet of flowers.
C holds a basket of offerings in front of a temple.
C places a basket of offerings on a stone ledge, then uses a paintbrush to apply paint to the offerings.
C paints a flower decoration on a temple ledge.
A person in traditional attire kneels before a temple, facing the steps leading up to it.

A person walks towards a traditional temple structure surrounded by lush greenery. The camera pans to reveal a wooden pavilion with a thatched roof, set amidst tropical plants and a stone pathway leading up to it.
The Samanvaya resort, featuring bamboo houses surrounded by rice fields, is shown from the interior, highlighting its serene and natural setting.
A serene outdoor pool surrounded by lush greenery and banana leaves, with a view of distant mountains under a clear blue sky.
The camera pans from a serene pool surrounded by lush greenery to a tranquil garden path lined with vibrant plants and trees, showcasing the natural beauty of the setting.
A view through a window with bars, showing a lush garden with trees and colorful flowers. The camera pans slightly to reveal more of the garden and a house in the background.
The camera pans from a view through a window with bars to an open landscape showing houses and trees under a clear sky.
A view of a rural landscape with houses and fields, showing a person working in the field.
A person walks through a field of crops, tending to them. The scene transitions to a view of terraced rice paddies surrounded by palm trees, indicating a rural farming environment.

Aerial view of terraced rice fields with palm trees in the foreground. The camera pans slowly across the lush green landscape, highlighting the intricate patterns of the fields and the calm water reflecting the sky. The scene captures the serene beauty of the rural setting.
The camera pans from a close-up of a rice field to a wider view showing traditional huts surrounded by lush greenery and palm trees under a cloudy sky.

A person wearing a conical hat walks along a narrow, tree-lined path in a lush, tropical setting. The path is surrounded by dense greenery and leads towards a rustic village with thatched-roof huts nestled among palm trees and mountains in the background.
C walks along a narrow forest path, carrying a bundle under one arm and wearing a conical hat and rubber boots. The path is surrounded by lush greenery and trees, creating a serene atmosphere.

A woman stands outdoors in front of a tropical setting, wearing a casual outfit and speaking directly to the camera. The background features lush greenery and a thatched-roof structure, suggesting a relaxed, natural environment.
C walks outdoors, passing by lush greenery and traditional huts under a clear sky.

A woman sits at an outdoor table, enjoying the scenic view of lush greenery and distant hills. She appears relaxed, with her legs crossed and hands resting on the table. The setting suggests a peaceful, rural location, possibly a resort or countryside home.
C picks up a glass of water from a table and takes a sip while seated outdoors.
C holds a glass of water, takes a sip, then lowers it. The scene shifts to C standing outdoors, gesturing with her hand while speaking.

The sun reflects off water surfaces, creating a shimmering effect. The scene transitions from a view of a resort area to a dark, silhouetted shot of trees reflecting in the water, suggesting a change in location and time of day.

A motorbike rider approaches a stone wall entrance with a lamp post and plants. The rider enters through the gate into a courtyard with a building in the background. The sun is shining brightly, creating reflections on the water surface.

A person rides a scooter towards a resort entrance. The resort features traditional thatched-roof huts surrounded by lush greenery. The scene transitions to black and white, showing the resort's exterior from a different angle.

The camera pans across a lush, tropical resort with thatched-roof huts nestled among greenery. The scene transitions to show a pathway leading up to the huts, with a view of the surrounding landscape featuring rolling hills and dense vegetation. The text overlay reads, 'just walked in the door and just looked out and thought to ourselves.'
A serene view of terraced rice fields surrounded by lush greenery under a clear blue sky.
A wooden surface with intricate geometric carvings is shown, highlighting the detailed craftsmanship of the design.
A wooden surface with intricate carvings is shown, followed by a shot of a luxurious bathroom with modern elements like a freestanding bathtub and a robe hanging on a hook.
The couple spent a year renovating the existing villas, adding elements of modern luxury, giving the joglo style pavilions a new lease of life.
A view of a circular roof structure with wooden beams and glass block windows, allowing natural light to enter the space.
The camera pans down from the wooden ceiling to reveal the natural stone walls of the room, which are made from Mount Agung stone.
The camera pans up to reveal the natural stone walls from Mount Agung, then moves to show the marble flooring, which is also a natural stone.
The marble flooring is a natural stone, that's you know.
C walks outside on a stone path wearing sandals, with shadows of leaves visible on the ground.
A woman walks through a modern kitchen, stepping onto a stone floor with her feet clad in sandals. The kitchen features dark cabinetry and pendant lights hanging above the counter.
C walks towards a glass door, revealing a view of a pool area with a woman standing near it. The camera pans to show the outdoor setting with greenery and a tree in the background.
C gestures towards the pool while speaking to a woman standing nearby. The woman listens attentively.
C gestures with their right hand while speaking, then moves their left hand to emphasize a point.
C gestures with her right hand while speaking, then turns slightly to the left, continuing to gesture with her left hand.
C walks towards a door, opening it to reveal a scenic view of green hills and a pool area outside.
C walks through a lush garden path, surrounded by greenery and plants.
Diah walks through a lush garden path, then looks down thoughtfully.
Diah Wahyuni, Customer Relations Officer at Samanvaya Resort, speaks about her family living in Sidemen Valley.
Diah Wahyuni, wearing a name tag, walks down a wooden staircase while speaking about her dream of working at Samanvaya Resort.
C walks down a wooden staircase, then the scene transitions to a wide shot of a rice field with text overlay about working there and seeing sunrise.
Aerial view of terraced rice fields with water reflecting sunlight, showcasing the intricate patterns and lush greenery of the landscape.
A woman smiles while holding a notebook, with a man laughing beside her. The text overlay reads 'THE 23-YEAR-OLD LEADS A COMMUNITY OUTREACH PROGRAM.'
A man picks up a bag of food from a pile, preparing to distribute it.
C holds a clipboard while standing next to a car, looking at something off-screen. The text overlay mentions plastic recycling efforts in local schools.
C places a clipboard on a table next to a bicycle wheel.
A man picks up a plastic bag from a pile of collected waste.

A woman walks down a palm-lined street carrying bags of recyclable materials. She passes by a house with a red roof and a motorcycle parked nearby. The text overlay mentions a monthly 'Plastic for rice' initiative and that villagers will come to Samanvaya.
C walks down a street carrying a large plastic bag filled with trash, passing by a pile of other bags containing more waste.
A man holds a plastic bag filled with trash while another person looks on. The man appears to be explaining something about exchanging plastic for rice.
C loads plastic bags into the trunk of a white SUV while speaking about rice exchange.
C writes on a notebook with a pen while standing next to a car trunk filled with boxes of rice.
C writes on a clipboard while another person sits beside her, holding a pen.
C picks up a yellow bucket from the ground while holding a white bag of rice with the other hand. Another person's hand is also visible holding the bag of rice.
C picks up a yellow bucket from the ground next to a white car and walks towards a white truck parked nearby. A person in the background is also walking towards the truck.

A group of people gather around a pile of bags and containers, some holding bags while others appear to be organizing or inspecting the items. The setting is outdoors near a building with a stone wall and trees in the background. The individuals are dressed casually, suggesting a community or volunteer event. The scene conveys a sense of teamwork and shared purpose.

A group of people stands near a pile of bags and containers, possibly sorting or organizing items. The background shows a rural setting with houses, trees, and mountains. The camera pans to reveal more of the surrounding landscape, including a house with a tiled roof and lush greenery.

A scenic view of a lush, green landscape with houses nestled among the vegetation. The camera pans slightly to reveal more of the surrounding area, including distant mountains and a clear sky. Subtitles appear at the bottom of the screen: 'What we want to do, is not just support the community.'
A man in camouflage runs past a hedge while holding a camera.
A person walks along a paved path lined with greenery, holding a camera and moving from left to right. The camera is positioned in front of them, suggesting they are filming the surroundings.
A woman sits in a chair outdoors, gesturing with her hands while speaking. The background shows a scenic view of green hills and a modern building.
A group of people walks through a garden, carrying a wooden box. The background features lush greenery and a building structure.
A person uses a tool to work on a small object, possibly jewelry, while a flame from a torch illuminates the workspace. The focus shifts slightly between the tool and the object being worked on.
A silversmith uses a torch to heat a piece of metal while another artisan works nearby in a workshop setting.
C holds a piece of fabric while another person weaves it on a loom. The camera focuses on the hands and the weaving process.
Two women walk down a tree-lined path in Sidemen Valley, passing by lush greenery and traditional structures.
C walks down a path, passing by lush greenery and palm trees. The camera focuses on a patterned fabric hanging from a wooden structure, revealing a room with shelves and various items inside.
C spreads out a patterned fabric on a table, smoothing it down with both hands.
C holds and flips through a book titled 'Kolektif', showcasing a patterned fabric design. The book mentions supporting local artists and craftsmen in Bali.

C holds a book titled 'Kolektif' showing a woman wearing a patterned dress. The background features various decorative items, including a chandelier and sculptures. The text on the screen reads: 'We support the local artists and our local craftsmen.'

A decorative metal piece with intricate patterns is shown hanging from a chandelier. The camera then pans to reveal a display of jewelry items, including a necklace with a large pendant and a bracelet, arranged on a stand with chains hanging down.
A woman speaks while holding a piece of jewelry, possibly explaining its value or purpose.

C holds a small object, possibly a piece of jewelry, while standing near a sink. A person lies on a massage table in the background, suggesting a spa setting. The text overlay indicates a discussion about supporting small artisans.

A person adjusts a mask on a seated individual's face while another person stands nearby, holding a tray. The setting appears to be a spa or wellness center. The seated individual remains still throughout the interaction.
A man in a uniform and traditional headwear looks down, possibly listening or thinking.
A woman speaks while looking to the side, with subtitles reading 'and coming here and being embraced by that'.
A group of people stands outside near a wooden cabinet and plants, exchanging a box among them.
A scenic view of a lush landscape with a pool in the foreground, surrounded by greenery and traditional structures under a partly cloudy sky.
The scene transitions from a serene outdoor setting with a pool and lush greenery to a black screen displaying credits.

Black screen with white text listing production credits: scriptwriter Sanjay Revee, production assistants Koh Jia Rong and Vivien Low, production intern Lucas Pestana, and others. The text scrolls upwards from bottom to top.
The screen displays the credits of the video production, listing the post-producer, editors, colourist, audio post producer, and music composer. The logo 'cna LUXURY' appears on a black background.
